hints.content: When Renata first moved in, the number of years since she moved in, $t$, was $0$.

We can calculate the height of the tree at that time:

$\begin{align} h&=210+33t\\\\
h&=210+33(0)\\\\
h&=210+0 \\\\
h &= 210 \end{align}$
The tree's height when Renata moved in was $210$ centimeters.

question.content:
Ever since Renata moved to her new home, she's been keeping track of the height of the tree outside her window.

The variable $h$ models the height of the tree (in centimeters), $t$ years since Renata moved in.

$h=210+33t$

**How tall was the tree when Renata moved in?**

[[☃ numeric-input 2]] centimeters
